name: SiteFlow 官方扩展插件包
description: SiteFlow 官方声明式扩展插件包，包含阅读进度条、代码块一键复制、空间状态徽章栏、简历求职状态条与大肥鱼深海主题，覆盖博客、空间与简历三大场景。
description_en: Official declarative plugin pack for SiteFlow featuring reading progress bar, one-click code copy toolbar, space status bar, print-aware resume availability ribbon, and DaFeiYu deep-sea theme.
author: SiteFlow
